guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Biogen is raising the lower end of the reported full year 2026 Non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance range to reflect ongoing business strength and Apellis dilution favorability. Full year 2026 Non-GAAP diluted EPS range is expected as follows:

FY 2026 Non-GAAP Diluted EPS Guidance | February 2026 | July 2026 | October 2026
Underlying guidance | $15.25 to $16.25 | $15.85 to $16.85 | $15.95 to $16.75
Expected approximate impact from acquired IPR&D, upfront and milestone charges | -- | ~($3.00) | ~($3.20)
Expected dilution from the Apellis acquisition | ~($0.85) | ~($0.55)
Reported Guidance | $15.25 to $16.25 | $12.00 to $13.00 | $12.20 to $13.00
Full year total revenue is expected to increase by a mid-single digit percentage for 2026 as compared to 2025 driven by continued growth from our Growth Portfolio.
Biogen expects combined Non-GAAP R&D expense and Non-GAAP SG&A expense to be approximately $4.95 billion for the full year 2026.
This guidance also assumes that foreign exchange rates as of October 23, 2026, will remain in effect for the remainder of the year, net of hedging activities.

Other than the acquired IPR&D, upfront and milestone impact expressly stated above, this financial guidance does not include any other potential future acquired IPR&D, upfront and milestone charges, impact from potential acquisitions or business development transactions or pending and future litigation or any impact of potential healthcare reform, as all are difficult to predict. Other important financial considerations will be provided on the conference call and webcast.

Biogen may incur charges, realize gains or losses, or experience other events or circumstances in 2026 that could cause any of these assumptions and expectations to change and/or actual results to vary from this financial guidance.
